overview_description.description: Structured AI reads building codes, standards, drawing, and project requirements to generate and update the technical documents that normally take weeks to complete. Its AI agents live inside software tools like Revit, Word, Excel, and SharePoint that mechanical, electrical, civil, and structural engineers already use.
